source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Once per battle for each Drakolithe token, you may use this ability when an enemy unit finishes a move up to 8" from this unit, if either:

- this unit is **[unengaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)**
- the enemy unit's move left it **engaged** with this unit

If you do, roll a D6: on a 3+, the enemy unit takes 1 **[mortal wound](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)**.

Keep 1 Drakolithe token beside the unit per Drakolithe it carries, and take 1 away per use.

engagementGate: moving enemy ended engaged with owning unit
detail.marker: 1 Drakolithe token beside the unit per Drakolithe carried; remove 1 per use
